# Known-failing tests on main. See docs/decisions/ADR-003-required-test-aggregator.md
#
# One entry per line: [flaky] [owner=<who>] [expires=YYYY-MM-DD] [issue=<ref>] <node id>
# Fields come BEFORE the node id (a parameter id may end in ` owner=b]`, no node
# id starts with `owner=`). A plain entry is ratcheted: once it runs and passes,
# the gate fails until the line is deleted. A `flaky` entry runs, never blocks,
# and must carry owner= and expires=. Expiry is reported weekly and enforced only
# on a PR that touches the test's file -- never on main or in the merge queue.
# MAX_QUARANTINE in scripts/ci_required_tests.py caps this file and ratchets
# down: deleting entries means lowering it (tests/test_ci_required_tests.py).
#
